description:
Activate Vish Kal's second ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, targeting itself.
Holding priority, activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Vish Kal.
Vish Kal triggers, giving it and all Vampires you control +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Honor-Worn Shaku ability, untapping it.
Activate Vish Kal's first ability by sacrificing it.
The Vish Kal abilities from step 1 and step 6 fail to resolve due to Vish Kal no longer being on the battlefield.
Vish Kal dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
